sections.title: CNTRL PLAINS/MID-UPPER MS VALLEY
sections.text: LATEST NAM/GFS MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGEST A BIMODAL CURRENT OF STRONGER FLOW ALOFT WILL TOP THE SWRN U.S. RIDGE ACROSS THE NRN ROCKIES AND DIG SEWD TOWARD THE MID-UPPER MS VALLEY LATE IN THE PERIOD. WITHIN THIS CURRENT OF STRONGER FLOW THERE APPEARS TO BE A WEAK DISTURBANCE THAT WILL TRAVERSE NRN WY BEFORE EJECTING INTO SD/NRN NEB DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON/EVENING HOURS. THIS FEATURE SHOULD ENCOURAGE CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT ALONG A FRONTAL ZONE THAT WILL EASE ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS DURING PEAK HEATING. IN FACT THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES WILL LIKELY BE QUITE UNSTABLE ACROSS SD WHERE FORECAST SOUNDINGS DEPICT SBCAPE ON THE ORDER OF 4000-5000 J/KG. WITH STEEP LAPSE RATES EXPECTED ALONG THE ADVANCING COLD FRONT THERE APPEARS TO BE SUFFICIENT DEEP LAYER SHEAR FOR DISCRETE SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT EARLY IN THE CONVECTIVE CYCLE SUCH THAT SUPERCELLS ARE ANTICIPATED. THESE STORMS COULD PRODUCE VERY LARGE HAIL...POSSIBLY IN EXCESS OF 2 INCHES. WITH TIME MULTIPLE STORM MERGERS AND A GRADUAL UPWARD EVOLUTION OF STORM COVERAGE WILL LIKELY RESULT IN ONE OR MORE MCS STRUCTURES. THIS ACTIVITY WILL THEN PROPAGATE SEWD ACROSS THE MID MO VALLEY ALONG AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY AIDED BY AN INCREASINGLY FOCUSE

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: WNWLY MID LEVEL WINDS ARE FORECAST TO STRENGTHEN FROM NRN ROCKIES EWD AND SEWD ACROSS THE GREAT PLAINS TODAY AS 500MB HEIGHT GRADIENT TIGHTENS BETWEEN EXPANSIVE SWRN U.S. ANTICYCLONE AND THE NEXT PROGRESSIVE SHORT WAVE TROUGH TO AMPLIFY ACROSS WRN CANADA. LOW AMPLITUDE PV WAVE TRAIN IS EVIDENT IN WATER VAPOR IMAGERY...WITHIN THE STRENGTHENING DEEP-LAYER FLOW ARCING FROM NRN CA ACROSS ID/MT TO WY. IN THE LOWER LEVELS...A BROAD ZONE OF SLY RETURN FLOW/WARM ADVECTION HAS BECOME ESTABLISHED ACROSS THE SRN/CNTRL PLAINS ON THE WRN FLANK OF A RETREATING SURFACE HIGH MOVING ACROSS THE UPPER MIDWEST. WHILE THE PATTERN ACROSS THE PLAINS TODAY WILL INCREASINGLY SUPPORT VIGOROUS/SEVERE CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT...THAT DEVELOPMENT MAY NOT NECESSARILY BE DRIVEN BY SYNOPTIC SCALE FORCING. IN FACT...IT APPEARS THAT THE EVENTUAL EVOLUTION OF THE LARGER SCALE PATTERN WILL BE DRIVEN PRIMARILY BY UPSCALE GROWTH OF THE AFTERNOON AND EVENING CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT. THIS RESULTS IN GREATER UNCERTAINTY IN THE OVERALL FORECAST SCENARIO. RECENT DEVELOPMENT ACROSS AR INTO NRN MS APPEARS TO HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO MOVE SOUTH INTO INCREASINGLY UNSTABLE AIRMASS SUPPORTIVE OF DAMAGING WINDS. THUS...A SLGT RISK HAS BE

sections.title: NRN TO CNTRL PLAINS
sections.text: SCATTERED TSTMS FROM ND TO AR THIS MORNING ARE OCCURRING WITHIN A BROAD N-S ZONE OF WARM ADVECTION AND MARK THE EDGE OF STRONGER CAPPING IN PLACE ACROSS THE PLAINS. MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES ACROSS THE PLAINS REMAIN VERY STEEP GIVEN THE WLY/NWLY FLOW ALOFT OFF THE HEATED TERRAIN TO THE WEST. MEANWHILE...A SWATH OF RICH LOW LEVEL MOISTURE WILL CONTINUE TO ADVECT NWD FROM KS ACROSS NEB AND SD RESULTING IN VERY UNSTABLE CONDITIONS LATER THIS AFTERNOON AHEAD OF A WEAK LEE/THERMAL TROUGH OVER NEB/SD AND COLD FRONT DEVELOPING SEWD FROM MT/ND. STORM INITIATION MAY OCCUR ON THE APEX OF THE LOW LEVEL WARM CONVEYOR BELT...FROM CNTRL/NERN NEB INTO SD...WHERE ANY REMAINING INHIBITION IS FORECAST BY SOME MODELS TO EVENTUALLY BE BREACHED. HOWEVER...STORM INITIATION SIGNAL IS HARDLY CONSISTENT ACROSS MODEL GUIDANCE THIS MORNING AND OTHER SCENARIOS INCLUDE STORMS DEVELOPING ALONG/AHEAD OF COLD FRONT ADVANCING FROM ERN MT/WRN DAKOTAS. PRONOUNCED DIRECTIONAL SHEAR IN THE STORM UPDRAFT LAYER WILL CONTRIBUTE TO DISCRETE SUPERCELLS EARLY IN THE DEVELOPMENT CYCLE. THESE STORMS COULD PRODUCE VERY LARGE HAIL...POSSIBLY IN EXCESS OF 2 INCHES...IN ADDITION TO A COUPLE OF TORNADOES. THE AREAS MOST LIKELY TO EXPE

sections.title: MN INTO SD
sections.text: STRONG HEATING IS OCCURRING TODAY OVER MUCH OF MN/SD. MEANWHILE...SOUTHWESTERLY LOW LEVEL WINDS ARE EXPECTED TO STRENGTHEN SOMEWHAT THROUGH THE AFTERNOON WHICH WILL HELP TO DRAW UPPER 60S DEWPOINTS THAT LIE FARTHER SOUTH INTO THE REGION. A CORRIDOR OF STRONG INSTABILITY WILL LIKELY DEVELOP FROM CENTRAL MN INTO CENTRAL SD WITH A RATHER WEAK CAP. SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE FORECAST BY MOST MODEL SOLUTIONS TO DEVELOP ALONG THIS CORRIDOR. EFFECTIVE VERTICAL SHEAR PROFILES AND STRONG CAPE SUGGEST THE RISK OF SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. AN ISOLATED TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT. STORMS WILL SAG SOUTHWARD THROUGH THE EVENING INTO SOUTHWEST MN AND EASTERN SD WITH A CONTINUED SEVERE THREAT.

sections.title: ERN SD/WRN IA/ERN NEB/WRN MO/ERN KS
sections.text: A WEAKENING LOW LEVEL BAROCLINIC ZONE IS PRESENT THIS MORNING FROM CENTRAL SD SOUTHEASTWARD ROUGHLY ALONG THE MO RIVER INTO MO. THE INSTABILITY GRADIENT IN THIS REGION IS BECOMING MORE DIFFUSE AS SURFACE DEWPOINTS MIX EASTWARD INTO IA/MN. NEVERTHELESS...THIS GENERAL CORRIDOR IS EXPECTED TO BE THE FOCUS FOR MULTIPLE ROUNDS OF STRONG/SEVERE STORMS THIS AFTERNOON AND TONIGHT. MULTIPLE MODELS INDICATE STORMS MAY DEVELOP BY MID AFTERNOON OVER SOUTHEAST SD AND TRACK ALONG THIS AXIS INTO IA. OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES FROM INITIAL STORMS MAY PROVIDE A FOCUS FOR RENEWED CONVECTION THROUGH THE EVENING. STRONG CAPE VALUES AND STRONG VERTICAL SHEAR WILL PROMOTE SUPERCELL STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. THE STRONG INSTABILITY EXTENDS WESTWARD ACROSS MUCH OF NEB...BUT A FORMIDABLE CAPPING INVERSION IS EXPECTED TO SUPPRESS ROBUST CONVECTION ACROSS CENTRAL/WESTERN NEB.

sections.title: MS/LA
sections.text: A PERSISTENT CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS OVER NORTHERN MS IS LIKELY TO TRACK SOUTHWARD ALL THE WAY TO THE GULF COAST. RATHER STRONG HEATING AND DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 70S WILL HELP TO MAINTAIN STORM INTENSITY. VERTICAL SHEAR IS WEAK AND STORM MOTION IS RATHER SLOW. HOWEVER...MESOSCALE ORGANIZATION OF COLD POOL MAY HELP TO PRODUCE LOCALLY GUSTY/DAMAGING WINDS ALONG THE MCS LEADING EDGE THIS AFTERNOON. ..HART/COHEN.. 08/18/2011

sections.title: MID-LOWER MO VALLEY/CNTRL PLAINS
sections.text: A LARGE CONGLOMERATE OF MULTI-CELL AND SUPERCELL UPDRAFTS ARE EVOLVING INTO AN MCS OVER THE MID MO VALLEY REGION OF NEB/IA INTO NWRN MO THIS EVENING. LEADING EDGE OF THIS ACTIVITY IS PROPAGATING SEWD AT ROUGHLY 30-35KT ALONG A WELL DEFINED INSTABILITY GRADIENT THAT IS SUPPLYING TSTMS WITH 3000-5000 J/KG MUCAPE. LATEST RADAR DATA SUGGESTS SEVERAL OF THE STRONGER CORES ARE LIKELY PRODUCING HAIL IN EXCESS OF 2 INCHES AND THESE LARGER HAILSTONES MAY BE NOTED FOR THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS AS INFLOW REMAINS FAVORABLE FOR MOIST/BUOYANT UPDRAFTS. IF ACTIVITY EVOLVES AS EXPECTED...MCS SHOULD EASILY SURGE SSEWD ACROSS NWRN MO/EXTREME NERN KS INTO PORTIONS OF CNTRL MO BEFORE GRADUALLY WEAKENING DURING THE OVERNIGHT HOURS OVER SRN MO. PRIOR TO LATE NIGHT WEAKENING DAMAGING WINDS MAY BECOME MORE COMMON AS OUTFLOW SURGES ALONG GRADUALLY EXPANDING PRECIP SHIELD. FRONTAL CONVECTION HAS GRADUALLY INTENSIFIED/EXPANDED ACROSS SD AHEAD OF SHORTWAVE TROUGH THAT EXTENDS ACROSS MB INTO THE DAKOTAS. WITH FAVORABLE DEEP LAYER SHEAR AND MODEST LARGE SCALE SUPPORT IT APPEARS TSTMS THAT EVOLVE ACROSS THIS REGION WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD/DEVELOP EWD INTO PORTIONS OF WRN MN LATE. sections.title: MIDDLE ATLANTIC/NERN U.S
sections.text: DIURNAL HEATING PROVED INSTRUMENTAL IN AIRMASS DESTABILIZATION ACROSS THE MIDDLE ATLANTIC/NERN U.S. TODAY. DESPITE WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR A SUBSTANTIAL NUMBER OF STRONG/SEVERE TSTMS DEVELOPED ACROSS NRN VA...SPREADING ACROSS THE DELMARVA INTO NJ OVER THE LAST HOUR OR SO. THIS ACTIVITY HAS OVERTURNED MUCH OF THE INSTABILITY EARLIER NEEDED FOR UPDRAFT INTENSITY AND WITH LOSS OF HEATING IT APPEARS REMAINING STORMS WILL MEANDER ABOUT AND WEAKEN QUICKLY AFTER SUNSET. ..DARROW.. 08/19/2011
